_doc: Reference rows `mise run triage` files as known: differences the repository already explains, so a triage lists only what is left to look at. `build` is a fragment of the build folder's name, `stats` the rows it explains, `reason` where the explanation is. Add an entry when a difference is documented as deliberate; remove it when the engine changes.

Doedre's Undoing spawns a Witchtoad every 0.25 seconds whatever the cast speed (docs/maintainer-guide.md, Doedre's Undoing)

Archmage adds a cost to Dark Consequences itself: Atalui converts it to Life and Efficiency II reduces it to 199, paid for each of 8 explosions/s (1592). PoB2 multiplies by the spell cast speed of 2.14/s (425.86), not its explosion rate (docs/maintainer-guide.md, Doedre's Undoing)

Doedre's Undoing spawns one Witchtoad every 0.25 seconds in each of two Cursed Ground areas, so Dark Consequences pays Archmage's added cost at 8 explosions/s. Atalui, Efficiency II and cost efficiency give 103.225806452 Life per explosion and 825.806451616 Life/s. The reference charges the same cost at 1.98 casts/s (204.387096774); pinned PoB2 likewise charges at cast speed (207.9), not explosion frequency (docs/maintainer-guide.md, Doedre's Undoing; crates/pobr-build/tests/skills/cost_rate.rs)
